# BetEdge — Full Site Directory & Data for AI Agents

> BetEdge (https://betedge.site/) is an independent betting-site and online casino comparison resource. We provide unbiased rankings, detailed reviews, rollover terms, payout metrics, and verified promotional codes.

## Site Structure & Navigation
- [Home](https://betedge.site/): Main comparison hub with top-ranked betting sites and welcome packages.
- [Reviews](https://betedge.site/reviews.html): Full table comparing score, bonus, live betting, cash out, and mobile compatibility.
- [All Games](https://betedge.site/games.html): Complete directory of reviewed betting apps and casino brands.
- [Bonuses](https://betedge.site/bonuses.html): Complete bonus tracker with promo codes and rollover information.
- [Guides](https://betedge.site/guides.html): Comprehensive wagering, bankroll, and withdrawal guides.
- [Blog](https://betedge.site/blog.html): Betting tips, bonus announcements, and industry updates.
- [About](https://betedge.site/about.html): Testing methodology, editorial standards, and scoring breakdown.
- [Contact](https://betedge.site/contact.html): Editorial contacts and partnership inquiries.
- [Responsible Gambling](https://betedge.site/responsible-gambling.html): 18+ policy, deposit limit guides, self-exclusion tools.
- [Privacy Policy](https://betedge.site/privacy.html): Data protection and privacy practices.
